style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で共用。役割と所在は原文の設定。年代・性別・外見・服装は今回の美術設定。小瓶・試験灯・樽・回収札・棚・寝具を人物画に固定しない。タルはq299でも同じ人物画を使う。
distribution: q296は生成PNGを原本と同一のまま配布する。既存q291〜q295の可逆WebPは維持する。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG. One centered adult person in a waist-up composition, complete head silhouette and both hands fully visible, lower edge below the waist, generous empty transparent margins beside the shoulders and above the head. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and wool, readable facial features, muted earthy colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. Deliver a PNG with genuine transparent alpha throughout the surrounding area. Clothing surfaces are plain and unlettered. Subject: Bek, an attentive inn steward working at a border settlement. He is a man in his early fifties with an average build, warm brown skin, a broad softly squared face, dark brown eyes, closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair and a neatly trimmed gray mustache. He wears a muted rust-red wool vest over a light oatmeal linen shirt with sleeves rolled neatly to the forearms, and a plain dark olive sash around the waist. His expression is thoughtful, patient and concerned about keeping guest lamps in good working order. Both empty hands are fully visible near the waist, one palm open in a small welcoming explanatory gesture and the other gently relaxed. His short salt-and-pepper hair, rust-red vest and oatmeal sleeves create a distinctive silhouette. The pose is balanced, approachable and suitable for conversation at an inn.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。成人1人を中央に置き、頭部の輪郭と両手全体が入り、腰より下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。肩の左右と頭上に十分な透過余白。1024×1536の縦画面。麻・ウールの質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。読み取りやすい顔、落ち着いた土色、左上から柔らかな暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。周囲の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。衣服の表面は無地。人物は国境宿場で働く、気配りのある旅籠の番頭ベク。50代前半の男性。標準的な体格、温かな褐色の肌、幅のある柔らかな角顔、濃褐色の目、短く刈った白髪交じりの髪と整えた灰色の口ひげ。明るい麦色の麻シャツに、くすんだ錆赤色のウールの胴着を重ねる。袖は前腕まで丁寧にまくり、腰には無地の濃いオリーブ色の帯。客の灯を安全に保つことを考える、思慮深く辛抱強い表情。空の両手全体を腰付近に見せ、一方の手のひらを小さく開いて説明し、もう一方は穏やかに力を抜く。短い白髪交じりの髪、錆赤色の胴着、麦色の袖で見分けられる。旅籠での会話に合う、安定した親しみやすい姿勢。
